data.title: Rich Text Blog Example - Complete Guide
data.description: A comprehensive example demonstrating all rich text content capabilities including markdown, images, code blocks, quotes, and more.

pageContent.content: Welcome to our **rich text** blog system! This example demonstrates all the powerful formatting capabilities available in our new blog content system. You can use *italic text*, `code snippets`, and [external links](https://example.com) directly in your content.

## Full Markdown Support

This is a complete markdown block that supports:

### Text Formatting
- **Bold text** with double asterisks
- *Italic text* with single asterisks
- `Inline code` with backticks
- ~~Strikethrough~~ text

### Lists

**Unordered List:**
- First item
- Second item with **bold text**
- Third item with *italic text*

**Ordered List:**
1. First numbered item
2. Second numbered item
3. Third numbered item

### Code Blocks

```javascript
// JavaScript example
function greetUser(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}

const user = 'World';
console.log(greetUser(user));
```

```python
# Python example
def greet_user(name):
    return f'Hello, {name}!'

user = 'World'
print(greet_user(user))
```

### Blockquotes

> This is a blockquote that can contain **bold text** and *italic text*.
> 
> It can span multiple lines and supports all markdown formatting.

### Tables

| Feature | Support | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| **Bold** | ✅ | Bold text formatting |
| *Italic* | ✅ | Italic text formatting |
| `Code` | ✅ | Inline code snippets |
| Links | ✅ | External link support |

### Links

- [External Link](https://example.com)
- [Internal Link](#introduction-to-rich-text-content)
- [Link with Title](https://example.com "Example Website")

Our rich text system supports **advanced features** like:

- Automatic *markdown detection* in any text content
- `Syntax highlighting` for code blocks
- **Responsive** image and video embedding
- Safe HTML sanitization for security
- Table of contents generation from headings

pageContent.content:
### Performance Considerations

When using rich text content, consider these performance tips:

1. **Optimize Images**: Use appropriate dimensions and compression
2. **Lazy Loading**: Images are automatically lazy-loaded
3. **Code Highlighting**: Syntax highlighting is applied on the client-side
4. **Sanitization**: HTML sanitization happens during rendering

### Security Features

- ✅ **XSS Prevention**: All HTML is sanitized
- ✅ **Safe Links**: External links open in new tabs
- ✅ **Content Validation**: Backend validates content structure
- ✅ **No Script Execution**: JavaScript is stripped from content

### Browser Support

| Browser | Support | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| Chrome | ✅ Full | All features supported |
| Firefox | ✅ Full | All features supported |
| Safari | ✅ Full | All features supported |
| Edge | ✅ Full | All features supported |
| Mobile | ✅ Full | Responsive design included |

Rich text content makes blogs more **engaging** and provides a better *user experience* with dynamic formatting, interactive elements, and `professional` presentation. The system is designed to be:

- **Easy to use**: Simple JSON structure
- *Flexible*: Supports multiple content types
- `Secure`: Built-in sanitization and validation
- **Responsive**: Works on all devices
- *Extensible*: Easy to add new content types

## Getting Started

To start using rich text content in your blogs:

1. **Update your API** to return content in the new format
2. **Test your content** with the provided examples
3. **Gradually migrate** existing content
4. **Enjoy** the enhanced user experience!

---

*This example demonstrates the full power of our rich text content system. Start creating more engaging blog content today!*
